paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.53% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.16%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.61%). Brent crude changed +5.70% to 111.96. Gold changed -2.81% to 4,052.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.24% to 81,188.0. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.97%, a relative move of -2.34%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-7.32%) and Blackstone (+6.92%) moved the most.
